basic_info.description:
In law garden apartment in safe, quiet neighborhood. One large bedroom with closet, 1 full bath, sitting room and full kitchen. Windows look out over backyard. Private entrance, access to yard from kitchen. Washer and dryer shared with other tenant. Close to U.C. , bus stop at the corner. On street parking, utility bills shared with other tenant. Bedroom 11 1/2 ' x 12', Sitting area 11 1/2' x 12', kitchen 11' x 8' approximates.
Available immediately.
